title: A ribbon for the star
scene: ROB threads a wide ribbon through a large star's hanging loop while Puppy sits on a round cushion; close side view.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original finished portrait children's coloring-book illustration, not a montage. Preschool ages 3-5: large easy-to-color closed spaces, broad shapes, expressive animation-quality drawing. Puppy is a small floppy-eared dog with plain collar. Include only characters named in the scene, never add ROB when it says no robot. Draw specifically the described action and viewpoint with natural interaction, not stock standing front view. Coherent scene, 4-6 main elements, big shapes and broad outlines.
